name: Start Bootstrap
summary: Free, open source Bootstrap 5 themes, templates and code snippets, with guides and tutorials.
description: An open source library of free Bootstrap themes, templates and code snippets maintained by David Miller, with guides and tutorials for Bootstrap development. The free templates and themes are MIT licensed and cover admin dashboards, landing pages, portfolio and blog themes; they can be downloaded as releases, installed from npm or cloned from GitHub, where 50 template repositories are published.
